<a id="room_band_colours"></a>
### [`room_band_colours`](../../../src/room_colours.asm#L25) `$47C8-$47D0`

*data*

Raster band colours: triplets ($D021, $D022, $D023), one per band. room_split_colour_ptrs points each room at 12 bytes (4 triplets) of this pool; the groups overlap. irq_frame_top ($4904) copies them to raster_colours every frame. A room shows triplets 0..n, n = number of lines in its raster list.

- **Entry of:** [`room_split_colour_ptrs`](../tables.md#room_split_colour_ptrs)

<a id="room_raster_split_lists"></a>
### [`room_raster_split_lists`](../../../src/room_colours.asm#L53) `$47F9-$47FB`

*data*

Raster line lists, one per room_raster_line_ptrs entry, each ended by $FD (room 0 list here). For line L, irq_colour_split starts the next colour triplet at raster line L+2 (late in the line) or L+3.

- **Entry of:** [`room_raster_line_ptrs`](../tables.md#room_raster_line_ptrs)
